# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH ENTEROBACTERALES

# Citrobacter freundii, Klebsiella aerogenes, or Enterobacter cloacae treatment

These organisms can develop resistance to certain beta-lactams (e.g.,

ceftriaxone) despite reported susceptibility or lack of resistance genes on

rapid diagnostic panels

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 7 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

< OR >

[Ertapenem 1 gm IV q24h R,O for 7 days](psjizid-ertapenem-1gm-iv-q24h)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Other Enterobacterales (E. coli, K. pneumoniae, P. mirabilis, etc.) treatment

# Ceftriaxone - susceptible or ESBL gene (CTX-M) not-detected

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h M for 7 days](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

# Ceftriaxone - resistance or ESBL gene (CTX-M) detected

[Ertapenem 1 gm IV q24h R,O for 7 days](psjizid-ertapenem-1gm-iv-q24h)

If critically ill:

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h R,O for 7 days](psjizid-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h)

# _______________________________________________________________________________
